title: Tactile Curiosity Drives Robot Interaction
title_zh: 触觉好奇心驱动机器人交互

paragraphs.en: Mastering robot manipulation skills via reinforcement learning (RL) remains largely sample-inefficient. The most common RL algorithms rely on random action sampling to discover new strategies, resulting in agents that allocate most of their training budget to motions in free space, away from the contacts from which manipulation skills emerge. Existing intrinsic motivation methods based on model disagreement or epistemic uncertainty improve on isotropic noise, but they can also reward uncertainty in functionally irrelevant transitions, such as erratic motions in free space. In this work, we argue that tactile feedback provides a natural signal for exploration, and introduce TacEx , a framework that incorporates touch into epistemic uncertainty-driven exploration by decomposing model uncertainty across sensory modalities and directing curiosity toward the tactile channel. By anchoring curiosity to the sense of touch, TacEx drives the robot to discover complex contact dynamics, learning to manipulate and grasp objects without task rewards or expert demonstrations during exploration. The interaction-dense dataset collected through this tactile-driven curiosity supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction. We further use tactile-driven exploration to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. Although the VLAs are initially pre-trained without tactile feedback, post-training with TacEx substantially improves downstream performance while remaining highly sample-efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 通过强化学习（RL）掌握机器人操作技能在很大程度上仍然缺乏样本效率。 最常见的强化学习算法依赖随机动作采样来发现新策略，导致智能体将大部分训练预算分配给自由空间中的运动，而远离了产生操作技能的接触行为。 基于模型分歧或认识不确定性的现有内源性动机方法虽然优于各向同性噪声，但它们也可能对功能无关的转换（例如自由空间中无规律的运动）给予奖励。 在本研究中，我们认为触觉反馈为探索提供了自然信号，并提出了 TacEx——一个将触觉整合到由认识不确定性驱动的探索框架中，通过分解不同感官模态下的模型不确定性，并将好奇心引导至触觉通道。 通过将好奇心锚定在触觉上，TacEx 促使机器人发现复杂的接触动力学，在探索过程中无需任务奖励或专家演示即可学会操作和抓取物体。 通过这种触觉驱动的好奇心收集到的密集交互数据集，支持了下游抓取与放置策略的离线学习，而无需额外的环境交互。 我们进一步利用触觉驱动的探索对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行后训练。 尽管 VLA 模型最初在没有触觉反馈的情况下预训练，但使用 TacEx 进行后训练显著提升了下游性能，同时保持了极高的样本效率。

paragraphs.en: Human babies learn to manipulate the world through touch [ 14 ] . Long before they can name an object or reason about its dynamics, they grasp, press, and reorient, and it is through these contacts that complex manipulation skills emerge. In fact, contact is the central piece of manipulation physics, and any agent that hopes to learn dexterous behavior must learn to seek out and understand contact.
paragraphs.zh: 人类婴儿通过触摸来学习操控世界 [ 14 ]。 在能够命名物体或推理其动态特性之前很久，他们就已经会抓握、按压和重新调整方向，而正是通过这些接触，复杂的操控技能才得以形成。 事实上，接触是操控物理学的核心要素，任何希望学会灵巧行为的智能体都必须学会寻找并理解接触。

paragraphs.en: By contrast, reinforcement learning typically discovers behavior by sampling actions isotropically. The consequence is an agent that allocates most of its training budget to motions in free space, far from the contacts that matter. In manipulation, the informative region of the state space is vanishingly small relative to its volume: a gripper a centimeter above an object and a gripper pressing into it occupy nearby states but induce entirely different dynamics, and only the latter teaches the agent anything about grasping. Random exploration is poorly equipped to discover this region, and once found, poorly rewarded to stay there.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，强化学习通常通过各向同性地采样动作来发现行为。 其结果是，智能体将大部分训练预算分配给了自由空间中的运动，而这些运动远离真正重要的接触点。 在操控任务中，状态空间中具有信息价值的区域相对于整个空间的体积而言微乎其微：一个位于物体上方一厘米处的夹具和一个按压在物体上的夹具虽然处于相邻的状态，却会引发完全不同的动力学行为，而只有后者才能让智能体学到任何关于抓取的知识。 随机探索难以有效发现这一区域，而一旦找到，也难以获得足够的奖励来维持该状态。

paragraphs.en: Intrinsic motivation [ 2 ] methods based on forward dynamics disagreement or epistemic uncertainty improve substantially on undirected noise [ 31 , 22 , 27 , 32 , 33 ] , but their curiosity remains agnostic to contact. The agent is rewarded for resolving uncertainty wherever it happens to lie, and is just as content hovering a manipulator through unexplored free space as it is dwelling on a contact to explore its dynamics. Worse, because interaction signals are sparse and arise only upon contact, the states an agent most needs to be curious about are precisely the ones it visits least.
paragraphs.zh: 基于正向动力学差异或认识不确定性的内在动机 [ 2 ] 方法，相比无方向性噪声 [ 31 , 22 , 27 , 32 , 33 ] 有显著提升，但它们的探索欲仍然无法识别接触事件。 无论不确定性出现在何处，智能体都会因消除这种不确定性而获得奖励；因此，它既可能让机械臂在未经探索的自由空间中悬停，也可能停留在某个接触点以探索其动力学特性。 更糟糕的是，由于交互信号稀疏且仅在接触时才会出现，智能体最需要产生好奇性的状态，恰恰是它访问最少的状态。

paragraphs.en: We argue that tactile feedback is the natural prior for where curiosity should point. The agent should not seek one-off contact, nor should it seek uncertainty uniformly across the state space; it should seek uncertainty in the tactile channel, and across the contact modes that touch exposes. This reframes exploration around a simple inductive bias: the value of resolving uncertainty is not uniform across the senses, and the sense of touch is the one whose uncertainty most reliably indicates that something worth learning is taking place.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，触觉反馈是决定好奇心应指向何处的自然先验。 智能体既不应追求一次性接触，也不应在整个状态空间中均匀地寻求不确定性；它应关注触觉通道中的不确定性，以及接触模式所揭示的各种接触方式中的不确定性。 这将探索重新定义为一个简单的归纳偏置：消除不确定性的价值在不同感官中并不均等，而触觉正是其不确定性最能可靠地表明有价值学习正在发生的一种感官。

sents.zh: 我们认为，触觉反馈是决定好奇心应指向何处的自然先验。

paragraphs.en: We introduce TacEx , a framework that builds on this idea ( fig. 1 ). Rather than treating epistemic uncertainty as a single scalar over the full state, TacEx decomposes it across sensory modalities and introduces a per-modality weighting on the resulting uncertainty terms. The key inductive bias is that the tactile component must be represented and weighted in the bonus, rather than, as in standard uncertainty-driven exploration, folding touch into an undifferentiated quantity where its contribution is diluted. With touch given non-negligible weight, the exploration bonus drives the agent toward contact-rich regions of the state space and rewards it for resolving the dynamics it finds there. The result is curiosity anchored to the sense of touch: the robot is drawn to contact, and it learns to grasp and manipulate objects without task rewards or expert demonstrations during exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 TacEx，这是一个基于这一理念构建的框架（图 1）。 与将认识论不确定性视为整个状态上的单一标量不同，TacEx 将其分解到不同的感官模态中，并对由此产生的各模态不确定性项引入模态特定的权重。 关键的归纳偏置在于：触觉成分必须在奖励项中被明确表示并赋予权重，而不是像标准的以不确定性为导向的探索方法那样，将触觉融入一个无法区分的总量中，从而稀释其贡献。 由于触觉被赋予了不可忽略的权重，探索奖励会引导智能体朝向状态空间中富含接触的区域，并奖励它解决在此处发现的动态特性。 最终，这种好奇心以触觉为锚点：机器人会被接触所吸引，并在探索过程中无需任务奖励或专家演示，就能学会抓取和操作物体。

paragraphs.en: This formulation yields three contributions. First, we introduce a modality-weighted exploration objective, motivated by information-gain exploration, that explicitly prioritizes tactile predictive uncertainty. Second, a pure tactile-driven exploration phase learns emergent grasping behaviors entirely from scratch, and the interaction-dense dataset it collects supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction. Third, the same principle makes the post-training of vision-language-action (VLA) models interaction-driven and sample-efficient: although these models are pre-trained without any tactile feedback, post-training with TacEx substantially improves downstream performance while remaining highly sample-efficient. We evaluate these claims in two simulation settings: reward-free exploration from scratch and sample-efficient post-training of frozen VLAs.
paragraphs.zh: 这一方法带来了三项贡献。 首先，我们引入了一种基于信息增益探索的模态加权探索目标，该目标明确优先关注触觉预测的不确定性。 其次，一个完全由触觉驱动的探索阶段能够从头开始学习出新的抓取行为，而它收集的高密度交互数据集支持了对下游抓取与放置策略的离线学习，无需额外的环境交互。 第三，同样的原则使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的后续训练变得以交互驱动且样本高效：尽管这些模型在没有触觉反馈的情况下进行预训练，但使用 TacEx 进行后续训练能显著提升下游任务性能，同时保持高度的样本效率。 我们在两种模拟设置中验证了这些主张：从头开始的无奖励探索，以及对冻结 VLA 模型的样本高效后续训练。

paragraphs.en: The exploration-exploitation trade-off represents a crucial challenge in RL. Should the agent exploit its current knowledge to greedily maximize the rewards or explore new policies in the hope of discovering a better solution? Common exploration strategies in RL are ϵ \epsilon -greedy, Boltzmann exploration, and maximizing information gain. We discuss these in the following.
paragraphs.zh: 探索-利用权衡是强化学习中的一个关键挑战。 智能体应该利用当前知识贪婪地最大化奖励，还是探索新策略以期望发现更优的解决方案？ 强化学习中常见的探索策略包括 ϵ \epsilon -greedy、玻尔兹曼探索和最大化信息增益。 我们将在下文中讨论这些策略。

paragraphs.en: Tactile feedback can be available in many forms, varying widely in the richness of the signal they provide. At the lowest end of the spectrum are binary contact sensors [ 42 ] , which report only whether contact is present, and force-torque sensors, which measure aggregate wrench at a single point but discard any spatial information about where contact occurs. In this work, we focus on high-dimensional tactile feedback, which, much like human skin, resolves contact spatially and reports the distribution of pressure and shear across the sensing surface.
paragraphs.zh: 触觉反馈可以以多种形式呈现，其提供的信号丰富程度也差异显著。 在这一系列中，最基础的是二元接触传感器 [ 42 ]，它们仅报告是否存在接触；而力矩传感器则测量单一点的合力矩，但会忽略接触发生位置的任何空间信息。 在本研究中，我们关注高维触觉反馈，它如同人类皮肤一样，能够分辨接触的空间分布，并报告传感表面上压力与剪切力的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: The most common forms of high-dimensional tactile feedback are tactile images [ 43 ] and force maps [ 30 ] , both of which are naturally interpretable as standard images and can therefore be processed with off-the-shelf vision architectures. Here we use force maps: a spatial binning of the contact patch in which each cell records the local pressure and shear forces, represented as a three-dimensional force vector. Because both representations share this image-like structure, force maps can be readily swapped for tactile images from vision-based sensors with little change to the rest of the pipeline, although its effectiveness with tactile images remains to be evaluated. We adopt force maps because they are convenient in practice: they are computable from real-world tactile sensors [ 30 , 28 ] and readily available in common simulation frameworks [ 29 , 1 ] , which makes them well suited for studying tactile-driven exploration in both settings.
paragraphs.zh: 高维触觉反馈最常见的形式是触觉图像 [ 43 ] 和力场图 [ 30 ]，两者都可以自然地解释为标准图像，因此可以使用现成的视觉架构进行处理。 在此，我们使用力场图：即对接触区域进行空间分箱，其中每个单元格记录局部压力和剪切力，并以三维力向量的形式表示。 由于这两种表示都共享这种类图像结构，因此几乎无需改动处理流程的其他部分，就可以将力场图轻松替换为来自视觉传感器的触觉图像，尽管其在使用触觉图像时的有效性仍有待评估。 我们采用力场图是因为它们在实践中更为便捷：它们可以从现实世界的触觉传感器 [ 30 , 28 ] 中计算得出，并且在常见的仿真框架中 [ 29 , 1 ] 也唾手可得，这使得它们非常适合在两种环境中研究以触觉为驱动的探索。

paragraphs.en: Prior work already uses touch to guide exploration. Vulin et al. [39] reward crossing a cumulative contact-force threshold and prioritize contact-rich replay; Huang et al. [11] combine impact penalties with surprise from an impact-penalty predictor; and Rajeswar et al. [25] combine visual-to-haptic prediction error with visual forward-model error. paragraphs.en: In the following, we present our experimental evaluation. The central hypothesis behind TacEx is that tactile feedback provides a crucial signal for enabling meaningful and directed exploration. To investigate this hypothesis, we first study whether touch encourages contact-rich exploration in simulation. We report means and standard errors over five seeds for reward-free exploration and ten seeds for diffusion steering.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将介绍我们的实验评估。 TacEx 的核心假设是，触觉反馈为有意义的定向探索提供了关键信号。 为了验证这一假设，我们首先研究触觉是否在模拟中促进接触丰富的探索行为。 对于无奖励探索，我们报告了五个随机种子下的均值和标准误差；对于扩散引导，则报告了十个随机种子下的结果。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the effect of tactile information during learning, we consider a reward-free exploration setting in which the agent optimizes only the uncertainty-driven intrinsic reward defined from eq. 4 , without access to task rewards. All modality-weighted exploration runs use zero extrinsic reward. We systematically ablate different weighting configurations ( ω 𝒗 , ω 𝜾 , ω 𝒛 ) (\omega_{{\bm{v}}},\omega_{\bm{\iota}},\omega_{{\bm{z}}}) in eq. 4 to analyze the relative contribution of visual, tactile, and latent uncertainty to exploration behavior. We also include a random-exploration baseline, which collects data using random actions without guidance from task rewards or model disagreement.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在学习过程中分离触觉信息的影响，我们考虑了一种无奖励的探索设置，其中智能体仅优化由公式 4 定义的不确定性驱动的内生奖励，而无法获取任务奖励。 所有模态加权探索运行均使用零外在奖励。 我们系统地消融了公式 4 中不同的加权配置（ω𝒗, ω𝜾, ω𝒛）(\omega_{{\bm{v}}},\omega_{\bm{\iota}},\omega_{{\bm{z}}})，以分析视觉、触觉和潜在不确定性对探索行为的相对贡献。 我们还加入了一个随机探索基线，该基线在没有任务奖励或模型分歧指导的情况下，通过随机动作收集数据。

paragraphs.en: To further assess the benefits of contact-rich exploration, we additionally consider a downstream sparse-reward pick-and-place task, where the objective is to grasp the object and lift it to a target location. The reward uses a finite-support tolerance margin around the spatial target, following the DeepMind Control Suite [ 36 ] . After reward-free collection, we freeze the replay buffer, relabel its transitions with this reward, and train SAC entirely offline, without further environment interaction. Importantly, during data collection, the agent is driven purely by the uncertainty-based exploration objective, without access to task rewards. Finally, we compare against an online RL baseline, DrQ [ 17 ] , trained directly on the sparse-reward task.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步评估接触丰富探索带来的益处，我们还考虑了一个下游的稀疏奖励抓取放置任务，其目标是抓住物体并将其抬升到目标位置。 该奖励在空间目标周围使用一个有限支撑的容差边界，遵循 DeepMind Control Suite [ 36 ] 的做法。 在完成无奖励的数据收集后，我们冻结重播缓冲区，用此奖励重新标记其中的状态转移，并完全离线训练 SAC，不再与环境进行交互。 重要的是，在数据收集过程中，智能体完全由基于不确定性的探索目标驱动，无法获取任务奖励。 最后，我们将该方法与一个在线强化学习基线方法 DrQ [ 17 ] 进行比较，后者是直接针对稀疏奖励任务训练的。

paragraphs.en: From fig. 2 , we draw several conclusions. First, incorporating tactile-driven disagreement increases the frequency with which the agent interacts with and attempts to grasp the object. In contrast, without tactile disagreement, the agent rarely engages with the object at all, suggesting that uniform uncertainty over the state space does not necessarily translate into meaningful exploration. This highlights the role of tactile sensing as an effective inductive bias that promotes contact-rich behavior in manipulation tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 从图 2 中，我们可以得出几个结论。 首先，引入触觉驱动的差异会增加智能体与物体互动并尝试抓取物体的频率。 相比之下，在没有触觉差异的情况下，智能体几乎完全不与物体互动，这表明状态空间中的均匀不确定性并不必然转化为有意义的探索。 这凸显了触觉感知作为有效归纳偏置的作用，它能在操控任务中促进富含接触的行为。

paragraphs.en: Interestingly, variants that prioritize tactile disagreement also induce substantially more object interaction than the sparse-reward online RL baseline and yield strong offline downstream performance on the pick-and-place task. In particular, policies trained on data collected with tactile-driven exploration achieve better offline returns, underscoring the importance of contact-rich data collection for subsequent reinforcement learning. This suggests that guiding exploration toward physically informative, contact-based experiences is critical for learning effective manipulation policies.

paragraphs.en: From fig. 3 , we further observe that tactile disagreement plays a crucial role in enabling contact-rich manipulation and strong offline pick-and-place performance. paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced TacEx , a framework that establishes tactile feedback as a core prior for directed exploration in robotic manipulation. By prioritizing tactile uncertainty, TacEx avoids the inefficiency of traditional reinforcement learning methods that spend large portions of training on uninformative free-space exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 TacEx——一个将触觉反馈确立为机器人操控中定向探索核心先验的框架。 通过优先处理触觉不确定性，TacEx 避免了传统强化学习方法中因在训练阶段花费大量时间进行无信息价值的自由空间探索而导致的低效问题。

sents.en: In this work, we introduced TacEx , a framework that establishes tactile feedback as a core prior for directed exploration in robotic manipulation.
sents.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 TacEx——一个将触觉反馈确立为机器人操控中定向探索核心先验的框架。

sents.en: By prioritizing tactile uncertainty, TacEx avoids the inefficiency of traditional reinforcement learning methods that spend large portions of training on uninformative free-space exploration.
sents.zh: 通过优先处理触觉不确定性，TacEx 避免了传统强化学习方法中因在训练阶段花费大量时间进行无信息价值的自由空间探索而导致的低效问题。

paragraphs.en: Our results show that tactile-driven curiosity enables the discovery of meaningful contact dynamics and emergent grasping behaviors without external rewards or demonstrations and the interaction-rich data collected through TacEx supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction. Furthermore, TacEx improves the sample efficiency of post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, despite the VLA itself being pre-trained with datasets without tactile observations. Finally, we find that tactile and visual uncertainty encourages both focused contact exploration and broader interaction diversity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，触觉驱动的探索能力使得无需外部奖励或演示，也能发现具有意义的接触动态和涌现的抓取行为；而通过 TacEx 收集到的富含交互的数据，支持了对下游抓取与放置策略的离线学习，且无需额外的环境交互。 此外，尽管 VLA 模型本身是在不包含触觉观察数据的数据集上预训练的，但 TacEx 仍提升了后训练阶段视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的样本效率。 最后，我们发现触觉和视觉上的不确定性既促进了有针对性的接触探索，也增强了交互方式的多样性。

sents.en: Our results show that tactile-driven curiosity enables the discovery of meaningful contact dynamics and emergent grasping behaviors without external rewards or demonstrations and the interaction-rich data collected through TacEx supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction.

sents.en: Finally, we find that tactile and visual uncertainty encourages both focused contact exploration and broader interaction diversity.
sents.zh: 最后，我们发现触觉和视觉上的不确定性既促进了有针对性的接触探索，也增强了交互方式的多样性。

paragraphs.en: Overall, these findings demonstrate that touch is not merely an observation modality, but a critical signal for efficient exploration and skill acquisition in robotic manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这些研究结果表明，触觉不仅仅是一种观察方式，更是机器人操作中实现高效探索与技能习得的关键信号。

paragraphs.en: Our study has several limitations that open avenues for future work. First, while we adopt force maps precisely because they transfer readily between simulated and real tactile sensors [ 28 ] , validating tactile-driven exploration on physical hardware—where contact is noisier and resets are costly—remains an important next step. We do not evaluate sensitivity to tactile noise, calibration drift, or sensor wear, and the present experiments do not establish whether these effects can be separated from uncertainty about contact dynamics. Moreover, contact-seeking curiosity does not itself enforce safe contact forces or prevent unintended interactions with distractor objects. Offline initialization and explicit safety constraints are possible directions for physical deployment, but their effectiveness with TacEx remains to be evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究存在若干局限性，这些局限为未来的工作开辟了新的方向。 首先，尽管我们采用力场图正是因为它能够在模拟触觉传感器和真实触觉传感器之间轻松迁移 [28]，但在物理硬件上验证由触觉驱动的探索仍然是一个重要的下一步——因为在物理环境中，接触会产生更多噪声，而系统重置的成本也更高。 我们没有评估对触觉噪声、校准漂移或传感器磨损的敏感度，目前的实验也无法确定这些效应是否可以与接触动力学的不确定性区分开来。 此外，接触寻求的好奇心本身并不能确保接触力处于安全范围内，也无法防止与干扰物体的意外相互作用。 离线初始化和显式的安全约束可能是物理部署的可行方向，但它们在 TacEx 中的有效性仍有待评估。

sents.en: Moreover, contact-seeking curiosity does not itself enforce safe contact forces or prevent unintended interactions with distractor objects.

sents.en: Offline initialization and explicit safety constraints are possible directions for physical deployment, but their effectiveness with TacEx remains to be evaluated.

paragraphs.en: Second, our experiments use a single parallel-jaw gripper and a single tactile representation; whether tactile curiosity scales to dexterous multi-fingered hands, richer contact modes, and vision-based tactile images is left open, though our pipeline is designed to accommodate such sensors with minimal modification. The evaluated tasks do not test fragile or deformable objects, or establish force regulation in tightly constrained manipulation. Third, the per-modality weights ( ω v , ω ι , ω z ) (\omega_{v},\omega_{\iota},\omega_{z}) are fixed hyperparameters. Our multi-object results suggest a tradeoff between focused contact exploration and interaction diversity that these weights control, and learning or adapting them online is a natural direction. Finally, while we show that tactile uncertainty improves the post-training of frozen VLAs, we do not explore whether the contact-rich data collected through TacEx could be fed back into pre-training, closing the loop between tactile exploration and large-scale policy learning.

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work leverages tactile sensing for robotic manipulation [ 37 , 7 , 18 , 41 ] . Prior works have shown that combining vision and touch can improve manipulation performance relative to using visual observations alone [ 6 , 29 ] . Beyond its role as an observation modality, tactile feedback has also been used explicitly to guide exploration during learning. Prior methods reward force magnitude [ 39 ] instead of epistemic uncertainty, curiosity over a scalar impact-force predictor [ 11 ] , or cross-modal prediction error that can conflate reducible epistemic with aleatoric uncertainty and uses aggregate force/torque with touch in the reward and state [ 25 ] . TacEx instead rewards modality-specific epistemic uncertainty, which decays as dynamics are learned, and uses spatial normal/shear force maps that preserve contact location, multiple contacts, rotation, and slip cues. Since tactile signals are inherently sparse and only available upon contact, exploration and learning with touch are especially challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究利用触觉感知进行机器人操作 [ 37 , 7 , 18 , 41 ] 。 先前的研究表明，结合视觉和触觉能够提升操作性能，优于仅使用视觉观察的方法 [ 6 , 29 ] 。 除了作为观察模态之外，触觉反馈也被明确用于在学习过程中引导探索。 先前的方法奖励的是力的大小 [ 39 ]，而非认识论不确定性、基于标量冲击力预测器的求知欲 [ 11 ]，或跨模态预测误差——后者可能将可消除的认识论不确定性与随机不确定性混为一谈，并在奖励和状态中综合使用力/扭矩与触觉数据 [ 25 ] 。 相比之下，TacEx 奖励的是特定模态的认识论不确定性（随着动力学模型的学习而逐渐降低），并使用空间法向/剪切力图来保留接触位置、多个接触点、旋转和滑移线索。 由于触觉信号本质上稀疏且仅在接触时才能获得，因此利用触觉进行探索和学习的难度尤其大。

paragraphs.en: Because informative contact signals arise only when the robot interacts with its surroundings, collecting useful tactile experience remains an exploration challenge. In this work, we study this problem and investigate how tactile feedback can be used to direct exploration in reinforcement learning. More specifically, we investigate the benefits of touch-driven exploration in visually guided manipulation tasks.

paragraphs.en: Efficient exploration remains one of the central challenges in reinforcement learning, particularly in high-dimensional continuous control problems. Classical approaches such as ϵ \epsilon –greedy exploration [ 16 , 21 , 38 ] and Boltzmann exploration [ 34 , 35 ] encourage exploration through randomized action selection or entropy maximization. While effective in simple settings, these methods explore indiscriminately and fail to account for the agent’s lack of knowledge about the environment. To address this limitation, several works propose uncertainty-aware exploration strategies that explicitly direct exploration toward poorly understood regions of the state-action space [ 31 , 33 , 22 , 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 高效的探索仍然是强化学习中的核心挑战之一，尤其是在高维连续控制问题中。 经典方法，如 ε-贪心探索 [ 16 , 21 , 38 ] 和玻尔兹曼探索 [ 34 , 35 ]，通过随机选择动作或最大化熵来鼓励探索。 尽管这些方法在简单场景下有效，但它们会无差别地探索，且未能考虑智能体对环境缺乏知识的问题。 为了解决这一局限性，多项研究提出了不确定性感知的探索策略，明确将探索方向引导至状态-动作空间中理解不足的区域 [ 31 , 33 , 22 , 5 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In particular, Sukhija et al. [31] formulate exploration as maximizing information gain by augmenting the policy objective with epistemic uncertainty estimates derived from learned dynamics models. Such approaches have demonstrated strong empirical performance [ 44 , 13 , 12 ] and improved sample efficiency in continuous control and visual RL tasks. An aggregate uncertainty objective, however, does not explicitly control the contributions of different sensory modalities. In robotic manipulation, informative interactions are often concentrated around contact-rich regions of the state space, suggesting that exploration should preferentially focus on tactile interaction. Our work builds on uncertainty-driven exploration and introduces a modality-aware exploration bonus that weights tactile uncertainty as a distinct term to guide exploration more effectively in manipulation tasks.

paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models, such as π 0 \pi_{0} [ 4 ] , can leverage large robot demonstration datasets that do not include tactile observations. Incorporating tactile feedback into such models at scale remains challenging, since it requires additional sensing hardware, calibration, and large multimodal datasets with aligned tactile observations and robot actions. FuSe [ 15 ] addresses this challenge by finetuning pretrained generalist robot policies on smaller heterogeneous-sensor datasets, using language as a common grounding space between modalities such as vision and touch. Tactile-VLA [ 10 ] incorporates tactile inputs into the VLA backbone and finetunes the model end-to-end to predict both motion and contact-force targets. In contrast, we ask whether touch can improve RL-based post-training while keeping the pretrained VLA and its input modalities unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，例如 π₀ [4]，可以利用不包含触觉观测数据的大型机器人演示数据集。 将触觉反馈大规模整合到此类模型中仍然具有挑战性，因为这需要额外的传感硬件、校准以及包含对齐的触觉观测和机器人动作的大型多模态数据集。 FuSe [15] 通过在较小的异构传感器数据集上微调预训练的全能型机器人策略来解决这一挑战，并利用语言作为视觉和触觉等模态之间的通用基础空间。 Tactile-VLA [10] 将触觉输入整合到 VLA 主干网络中，并对模型进行端到端微调，以同时预测运动目标和接触力目标。 相比之下，我们探讨的是：在保持预训练的 VLA 及其输入模态不变的前提下，触觉是否能够在基于强化学习的后训练阶段带来改进。

paragraphs.en: We compare four diffusion-steering variants. DSRL-SAC is the standard diffusion-steering baseline: an MLP policy π 𝒘 \pi^{\bm{w}} is trained with SAC to predict the latent noise 𝒘 t {\bm{w}}_{t} from the current state 𝒔 t {\bm{s}}_{t} , while the frozen VLA policy π 0 \pi_{0} maps this noise to actions. This method uses visual and proprioceptive observations, but no tactile input. DSRL-Tac-SAC uses the same SAC learner in the latent-noise action space, but augments the learner state with tactile observations 𝜾 t \bm{\iota}_{t} from the gripper. This baseline tests whether tactile information improves diffusion steering as an additional observation modality, without changing the exploration objective.

paragraphs.en: We then add exploration that explicitly seeks informative transitions in the latent-noise MDP. For this, DSRL-MaxinfoSac and DSRL-TacEx train an uncertainty-aware statistical dynamics model on the online replay buffer ( 𝒔 t , 𝒘 t , r t , 𝒔 t + 1 ) ({\bm{s}}_{t},{\bm{w}}_{t},r_{t},{\bm{s}}_{t+1}) . The model takes the current learner observation and the predicted noise action 𝒘 t {\bm{w}}_{t} as input, and predicts the resulting transition in selected observation modalities, as well as the task reward. We represent this model as an ensemble, so that epistemic uncertainty can be estimated from the disagreement between ensemble members [ 23 ] . Intuitively, if different ensemble heads make different predictions about what will happen after applying a noise action 𝒘 t {\bm{w}}_{t} , then executing this noise action is expected to provide information about the latent-noise MDP.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们加入了一种探索机制，该机制明确地在潜在噪声马尔可夫决策过程（latent-noise MDP）中寻求具有信息价值的状态转移。 为此，DSRL-MaxinfoSac 和 DSRL-TacEx 会在在线重播缓冲区（𝒔 t , 𝒘 t , r t , 𝒔 t + 1）({\bm{s}}_{t},{\bm{w}}_{t},r_{t},{\bm{s}}_{t+1}) 上训练一个具备不确定性感知能力的统计动态模型。 该模型以当前学习者的观测结果和预测的噪声动作 𝒘 t {\bm{w}}_{t} 作为输入，并预测在选定的观测模态中由此产生的状态转移，以及任务奖励。 我们将此模型表示为一个集成模型，以便能够通过集成成员之间的预测差异来估计认识论不确定性 [23]。 直观而言，如果不同的集成头对执行噪声动作 𝒘 t {\bm{w}}_{t} 后可能发生的情况做出不同预测，那么执行该噪声动作预计将提供有关潜在噪声马尔可夫决策过程的信息。

paragraphs.en: DSRL-SAC trains the noise-prediction policy using only the sparse task reward. In contrast, DSRL-MaxinfoSac augments this reward with an intrinsic bonus proportional to ensemble disagreement, encouraging the policy to choose noise actions whose outcomes are informative under the learned latent-noise dynamics model. DSRL-TacEx uses a similar maximum information objective, but additionally receives tactile observations whose embeddings 𝜾 \bm{\iota} are included in the state 𝒔 {\bm{s}} and may include the tactile modality when computing disagreement with different weights. This tests whether tactile uncertainty provides a useful exploration signal for discovering contact-rich behavior.

paragraphs.en: The results in fig. 5 support two conclusions. First, tactile observations improve the diffusion-steering state representation: for the same disagreement modality, solid DSRL-TacEx curves consistently outperform their dashed DSRL-MaxinfoSac counterparts, which do not receive tactile input. Second, exploration itself is important, as the colored DSRL-TacEx variants improve over the black SAC baselines. However, the strongest performance is obtained when tactile information is used not only as an observation, but also as part of the disagreement signal. When DSRL receives tactile observations but computes disagreement only over non-tactile modalities, performance degrades relative to tactile-disagreement variants. This indicates that touch is most useful when it directly guides epistemic exploration toward contact-rich transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 图5中的结果支持两个结论。 首先，触觉观察能改进扩散引导的状态表示：对于相同的分歧模态，实线DSRL-TacEx曲线始终优于虚线DSRL-MaxinfoSac曲线，后者未接收触觉输入。 其次，探索本身也很重要，因为带颜色的DSRL-TacEx变体在性能上优于黑色的SAC基线模型。 然而，当触觉信息不仅被用作观察，还被用作分歧信号的一部分时，才能获得最强的性能。 当DSRL接收触觉观察，但仅对非触觉模态计算分歧时，其性能相较于结合触觉分歧的变体会下降。 这表明，当触觉信息能直接引导认识论探索朝向接触丰富的状态转移时，其效用最大。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 compares five LIBERO tasks: ketchup in tray (58), soup in tray (55), butter in tray (56), book to back caddy (77), and stove and frying pan (21). The added “summed taxels” baselines either use the aggregate signal directly as a diffusion-steering reward, approximating force-magnitude intrinsic rewards, or use the ensemble disagreement when predicting the same signal as a MaxInfoRL bonus [ 31 ] . This isolates the value of spatially resolved tactile uncertainty. DSRL-PPO and DPPO test post-training; DSRL-PPO replaces SAC with PPO while keeping the setup and interaction budget fixed.
